scope: Target KiCad 10.0.7 (latest stable, 2026-10-07) kicad-cli: saved two-copper-layer board statistics, native DRC JSON with authored maximum counts, decimal absolute Excellon drill export; independent host board reader, statistics/DRC/drill-hit cross-checks and captured-input mutation checks. No board authoring, zone refill, schematic parity, Gerber/STEP/position outputs, slots, blind/buried vias or drill maps.
acceptance: Run tools/qualify_kicad.py with the target kicad-cli; require the baseline/variant fixtures to verify, the clearance and open-net fixtures to fail with DRC_VIOLATIONS matching host predictions, tamper/mutation probes to fail, and native adaptor conformance to pass.
